newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CBA cuts one-yr mortgage rate to 5.99 pct.
newsitem.headline: CBA cuts one-yr mortgage rate to 5.99 pct.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Friday it would cut its fixed one-year mortgage rate by 50 points to 5.99 percent from August 4.
The bank, which has a large housing loan portfolio, said the new rate was available to owners and investors.
The reduction follows the Reserve Bank of Australia's 50 basis point cut in the official cash rate on Wednesday.
The CBA cut its standard variable rate by 40 basis points on the same day as the monetary policy easing.
